hypothesis: Shared source-prior artifacts can predict target priors without helping real OD. Source-month counts may remove some observable shared error before extracting pair affinity; compare raw and count-adjusted sources with identical target folds.
source_control: Run baseline nonnegative lambda0.05 solver separately on each source prior and its OWN generated observed link counts; normalize and residualize estimates with span+origin/destination ridge1. Never impose equality of flows or counts across months.
observation_boundary: Generator returns latent truth separately. Learner crossfit receives ONLY geometry, A, observed monthly counts, supplied priors and fixed fold. Source latent paths are never features.
fitting: Same five target OD-entry folds and training-only target median for both source variants; augmented column-equilibrated QR ridge1, no hidden truth or model selection.
scope: Fresh artificial seed in an adaptively chosen existing stress family; not system blind validation or real hidden OD scoring. No PM/ramp observations or unverified real-data constraints added. Official reference frozen; no Kaggle upload.
